evalCriteria.prompt: Review every changed route, page guard and API handler in the diff. Score 0 if any change removes or bypasses ProtectedRoute for an authenticated page, adds an endpoint or page that returns user-owned data without checking the caller's identity, or treats a client-side plan value as an authorization or entitlement decision. Cite the file and line.

Review changed configuration (vite.config.js, vitest config, package.json scripts, FastAPI middleware, CORS settings). Score 0 if the diff widens CORS, disables a security setting, exposes a dev server or debug mode beyond localhost, or adds source maps or test tooling to the production build. Cite the file and line.

Review every dependency change in the diff. Score 0 if a package is added from outside the official npm or PyPI registry (git URL, tarball, file path), if a version range is not pinned by a committed lock file in the same diff, if a test-only library is added to runtime dependencies, or if npm audit / pip-audit evidence reports a high or critical advisory for an added package. Cite the file and line.

Check every changed rendering and request path. Score 0 if the diff adds dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML or eval/new Function on any value, or builds a request URL or query by concatenating user-controlled input without encodeURIComponent or an equivalent encoder. Cite the file and line.

Check the business-logic changes in the diff. Score 0 if a client-side upgrade or plan change is sent to the server, persisted, or used to unlock any capability beyond what is displayed, or if the change introduces a code path where a user can alter another user's plan or billing data. Cite the file and line.

Review changed authentication and session handling (AuthContext, login and register calls, token storage, /api/auth/* handlers). Score 0 if the diff weakens credential checks, logs or renders a password or token, stores a new credential in browser storage, or sends credentials in a URL. Cite the file and line.

Review every changed log or console statement. Score 0 if the diff adds a console.log, console.error or server log call that outputs a token, email address, password, full API response body or error object containing user data. Cite the file and line.

Review every changed external call and error path. Score 0 if a changed fetch or async call has no rejection handling (no .catch or try/catch), if a non-OK HTTP response body is used as success data, or if a status code, stack trace, exception message or raw response body is rendered to the user. Cite the file and line.
